verdict.rationale: The only scheduling evidence is Fieldwork marketing copy saying its AI agents collect and package evidence 'on your schedule', plus a fixed daily code-security scan that users can trigger manually but not configure. Neither shows users defining their own recurring jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable schedules (cron or intervals) for jobs/workflows, scheduling of agent/MCP-driven automations, first-party docs beyond marketing claims, independent or hands-on corroboration.
